- Only touch lines marked with ">" (the changed lines) or a line directly next to them.
- Keep each mutant minimal (at most 5 lines) and syntactically valid. Never touch test files.
- Prefer semantic faults over syntax noise. Consider these bug classes: off-by-one, wrong boundary, missing case, wrong branch order, wrong default, partial fix that only handles the reported example, silently swallowed error, wrong unit or rounding, state not reset, inverted condition.

- plausibility: 5 = very likely real-world mistake, 1 = contrived.
